More than 130 million names have reportedly been deleted nationwide since the process began in Bihar.

Al Jazeera's Um-E-Kulsoom Shariff reports from New Delhi, India.

author: Al Jazeera English
description:
An ultra-Orthodox Jewish group, Neturei Karta, rejects Zionism and refuses to recognise the State of Israel while marching under the Palestinian flag. This documentary traces its story from early 20th-century Jewish opposition to Zionism to today’s street protests in Jerusalem and New York. Told through Neturei Karta’s own voices and critical historians, the film revisits the Balfour Declaration, the assassination of Jacob Israel de Haan, the Holocaust-era split that gave birth to the movement, and the group's marginal but defiant stance after Israel’s creation in 1948. Facing police crackdowns, death threats and isolation from mainstream Jewry, Neturei Karta has deepened its ties with Palestinians - from the streets of Mea She’arim in West Jerusalem to Yasser Arafat’s inner circle and solidarity with Gaza under blockade. Its story challenges assumptions about Judaism, Zionism and resistance in a region locked in conflict.

A normally busy shipping corridor now shows little sign of commercial vessels, with Djiboutian naval patrols and military aircraft the main visible presence. The strait separates Djibouti on the African side from Yemen on the Arabian side, with the Djiboutian side offering deeper waters and being considered more secure. Despite the strategic importance of the passage, no breaches or security incidents have been recorded in the area visited by the Al Jazeera team, while international coalition warships are not visibly present. The sharp decline in commercial shipping highlights how the conflict and insecurity have disrupted one of the world's most important trade routes.

author: Al Jazeera English
description: A war crimes tribunal in The Hague has sentenced former Kosovo President Hashim Thaci to 25 years in prison for war crimes dating back to the 1990s war of independence from Serbian control. While judges rejected the charges of targeting a civilian population, Thaci and his co-defendants were convicted of murder, cruel treatment, torture and arbitrary detention. The panel found all four accused — Thaci, Veseli, Selimi and Krasniqi — criminally responsible through their significant contribution to a joint criminal enterprise. The convictions cover arbitrary detention involving 385 individuals, cruel treatment involving 49, torture involving 303 and murder involving 96. Prosecutors had been seeking 45 years in prison for Thaci. There has been an angry response in Pristina, where thousands of Kosovo Albanians see Thaci not only as the country's former president but also as a symbol of Kosovo's liberation, making the judgment particularly painful for many. description: A residential building in Gaza City has collapsed, leaving at least 70 people missing, including children. Families had no other choice but to shelter inside the partially damaged structure, which collapsed as they were sleeping at around 1am. Rescue crews and residents have been digging through the rubble, with a lack of heavy equipment making rescue operations more difficult.
